tei:div.tei:p: gnod sbyin sprul pa rnam rgyal gling pa'i byon tshul bzhugs so/ /

oṃ swa ti/ 'gro ba'i gtsug rgyan dpal ldan sa skya pa'i/ /sku ring las byung dpon chen nye gnas sogs/ /rab dang rim par byung pa mang mod kyi// phyi'i bskor bla brang kho na'i bya ba rnams/ /ches lhag phul phyin sgrub pa'i nyai gnas mchog|dam tshig gtsang zhing bsod nams dpal gyi mtho/ /zas nor dbang 'byor gnod sbyin sprul par grags/ /byas pa lag rjes che ba 'di ltar byung*/ de 'ang sngon pu rgyal bod 'di/ chos skyongs ba'i rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sku'i ring la/ za hor kyi yul nas/ mkhan po ho dhi sa twa gdan drangs nas/ bla ma'i mchod gnas su bkur/ bod du btsun pa la snga ba/ sad mi mi bdun bya ba rab tu byung nas/ 'khor mang po dang bcas te/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar bar mdzad | de dang dus mnyam du nub phyogs dbu rgyan gyi yul nas/ slob dpon padma 'byung gnas gdan drangs/ bod kyi lha klu gdug pa can dam la btags/ rgya gar o tan ta pu ri'i gtsug lag khang la dpe blangs nas/ ri rab gling bzhi gling phran nyi zla lcags ri mu khyud dang bcas pa/ dpal bsam yas lhun gyi grub pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po bzhengs/ bod rgyal po'i bla mar mnga' gsol/ de'i dus su u rgyan pad ma'i dngos slob gnyag dang*/ 'khon rdo rje rin chen dang | swa zur snubs gsum la sogs/ dkyil 'khor gtso brgyad du grags pa byung | de rnams kyi nang nas/ dbas kyi ston pa a mes mtshan rdo rje rgyal mtshan bya ba/ bdud rtsi yon tan gyi lha tshogs la thugs dam gyi gtso bo mdzad cing*/ chos skyong tshogs bdag dkar dmar/ bran du 'khol nus pa gsang sngags rnying ma'i grub thob chen po gcig dang*/ dbus ru skyi shod kyi lung par/ zul bu 'o ma'i nags 'dabs su byung te/ bla ma de nyid kyi zul phu gnas gsar gyi dgon pa btab/ sngags pa'i grwa bu slob mang po bskyangs nas/ gsang sngags kyi bstan pa dar bar mdzad/

de nas bzung ste/ rgyud pa bcu tsam gyi bar la/ gnam la rdo rje'i gur ma zhig pa/ sa la dkyil 'khor gyi bkrag ma yal ba/ bar na rag ta'i mtsho ma bskams pa'i/ sngags 'chang grub pa thob pa mang po byung ngo*/ /de skabs su hor sa skya ba yon mchod du 'brel nas/ bod chol kha gsum po la sa skya bas kha lo sgyur ba'i dus/ gnas gsar sngags pa'i dbon rgyud/ dbon po dkon mchog skyabs zer ba zhig byung ba des/ dpal ldan sa skyar bla ma bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal ba yab sras kyi zhabs la thug sa skya nang so dang*/ chu mig khri khang lo 'ga' bzung*/ nye gnas chen po 'gon po skyabs zhes par grags pa de'i ring la/ gtsang stod lhan lung gi sa cha dang*/ 'aspas rnams klapa rnamabluphyogs kyi sa phran 'dra bdag tu bzung bar 'dug 'di yan la so sor gyes pa'i rus mtshams ni/ rta nag phul pa/ dpon dgos pa rin chen pa skor yang yin par byed cing*/ zul phu phyogs na'ang da lta yang*/ sngags rgyud 'dzin pa mang rab yod par 'ganangaklasnangablu/ nye gnas chen po mgon po skyabs pa la/ sras po mched gsum byung ba'i che ba/ chen po don grub rgyal mtshan pa de bstan pa'i mnga' bdag ti shri kun blo'i zhabs la gtugs/ bod khams su gdan sa bar ba/ rtse 'od bsam grub kyi nye gnas chen po dang*/ sho tham kha gnang*/ de nas bzung 'phags pa kun blo gshegs nas/ ti shri kun rgyal ba'i phyag phyi mthil byas/ gong la byon bla mas thugs la btags nas/ pho grang ta'i tur/ rdzong kha bu'i khrims ra dang*/ nye gnas chen po la bskos/ bod la 'byon khar gong ma tho gon thi mur rgyal pos/ du dben shri mtshan dang lung lag rtags bzang po gnang zhing*/ khyad par yab yum gtsang stod lhan lung gi 'og tu lhan gangs gdong yan/ span smad jo bo rigs gsum mgon po man 'aspas rnams klapa rnam blu gyi gzhis phran rnams dang bcas pa gtsang gzhis su 'jags pa'i/ 'ja' sa chen mo gnang*/

yar phebs nas kyang lha khang bla brang bas gdung rgyud yab sras rnams kyis zhabs tog tshul bzhin sgrub par gda'o/ /de'i gcung chen po/ dpal ldan rgyal mtshan pa des/ ti dben gu shri kun dga' nyi mas thog drangs 'jam dbyangs don yod rgya mtshan pa sku mched pa'i phyag phyir sleb/ rin chen sgang bla brang ba'i nye gnas chen po mdzad/ rin chen sgang gi lcags ri chen mo dang*/ sgo spe shar nub/ gar phu'i phyogs bzhis kha khram mo/ /bo dong e'i lcags ri phyi ma/ sgo lcog 'khor ma/ nang du bud rtse gsar ma/ phyi ru mgron khang skar bcas/ gzhan yang bo dong ma las dga' ba'i bu bzhir grags pa'i gzhis 'daga' klakablu/ bkra shis sgang*/ rog tshe/ shab dge sding*/ 'jad mthong smon ma sogs/ gzhis che chung mang po'i mkhar las gsar brdungs zhabs su phyug par bzhengs/ mdor na bla brang gi bya ba kho na la gtso bor ston pa'i nang gi gsog mchog phyis 'dul skyong dgos pa gang la'ang*/ phyis skor gyi nye gnas chen mo rnams kyi nang nas/ 'di nyid bya ba lag rjes shin klatubluche bar grags so | | gcung chung shos chen po nor bu bzang po bas/ gcen gyi rjes su 'brang ste | bo dong gi nye gnas chen po mdzad/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dang chos rje bsod rgyal ba/ chos 'khor chen mo skor ba'i mthu rkyen/ brjid khur mthil gzhu sogs rin chen sgang pa'i gdung rgyud zhal ngo rnams kyi zhabs tog bsgrubs/ gcung po slob dpon chen po bsod nams yon tan pas rab tu byung nas dpal bo dong e'i chos dpon mdzad do/ /gcen po don rgyal du dben shris/ jo mo khams mo la/ sras gcig byung ba ni/ dbang hu bsod nams rgya mtshan pa'o/ / yang jo mo gtsang mo la sras slob dpon don grub rgyal mtshan pa byung nas/ rin chen sgang dang bo dong du thog gcig bzhugs nas/ chen po grub rgyal du grags so | | des rtsa ba'i gzhis/ gtsang stod lhan lung gi skor rnams sgaus bdag tu bzung de'i dbon sras kyi rgyud dang*/

lhan lung pa yab sras rnams yin no/ / dbang hu chen po de nyid kyis sku gzhon nu'i dus dpal bo dong e'i chos grwa chen por dpang lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa'i drung du/ rab tu byung nas mngon pa mdzod la slob gnyer mdzad pa'i/ dge bshes su grags/ de'i skabs su/ bla chen bsod blo ba sku mched/ dus mchod bla brang nas/ stag tshang rdzong khar phebs pa'i phyag phyir byon/ gsol gzim mdzad pa gang la'ang 'jug pa'i las tshan mthil bzung | zhabs tog la brtson cing*/ phyi nang gi bya ba la mkhas pas/ bla chen pa shin tu mnyes nas/ gong la 'jon pa'i phyag phyir khrid/ bla ma'i sku drin la/ gong ma thog gan the mur rgyal pos/ ri tsing dbang gi las 'dzin/ khrims ra brgyad yod pa'i che shos g.yas phyogs kyi dbang hu'i mtshan dang*/ dam rtags lung bzang po dang bcas pa gnang*/ yar phebs nas pa'i lan dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan pas bka' lung ji ltar gnang pa bzhin/ las stod mnga' ris kyi phyogs la lam 'phrang dgra gnyen gang la'ang ma bsam par byon nas/ dgra phyogs 'dul ba dang*/ rang phyogs bstod pa la sogs bya ba chen po rnams/ dpon po'i dgongs pa dang mthun par grub nas phyir phebs dus/ dpon sa nas kyang mnga' ral gsum gyi sa gdan/ lha sde mi sde/ ya mi snya ban gyis rus sde dang bcas pa/ bzhengs te dpa' zhal la gnang*/ stag tshang rdzong gong 'og gi sne las nye gnas chen mo la bskaus/ mi dbang chen mo rang gi sras mo/ byang sems bsod nams rgyal mo ba khab tu gnang ba la sogs/ gdung rus las chad pa'i dbon sras ngo bo dang 'dra bar 'jog klapa blusogs/ thugs 'dogs shin du che bar mdzad cing | dpon sa'i thugs 'dogs dang*/ khong rang yang rgyal khrims 'akyiklakyis blubya ba la mkhas shing*/ sku bsod kyi dpal gyi mngon par mtho bas/ dgra 'dul gnyen skyong sde srid mdzad 'phrin mtha' dag lhun gyis grub nas/ chu mo phag gi lo hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes bco lnga bza' skar dus tshes 'phrod sbyor kun bzang ba'i nyin nas/

rdzong rnam rgyal gling chen gyi 'gram bting*/ ring por ma thogs par zhabs su phyug par bzhengs/ mnyam med rgyal ba bzang po'i thog drangs | bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen bzang grags mang pa'i rdzong la rab gnas gsol/ sbyin bdag rang gi yi dam gyi mtshan dang mthun par byed gsung nas | rnam rgyal gling chen zhes par ming btags/ son wi pa'i mi dpon chen mo 'di nyid ni bzang zhing dpa' ba/ mthu stobs zas nor la dbang 'byor pas/ rang gzhan gyi mnga' zhabs thams cad/ bde ba la bkod pa'i snyan grags kyi dbus gtsang thams cad khyab par gyur cing*/ gnod sbyin tshogs kyi bdag po'i sprul par grags so/ /de nyid kyi jo mo sngon ma 'bri gung rgung khar dbon mo la/ sras drung chen chos rgyal bzang po ba byung zhing*/ gdung rgyud lcam mo la/ thog mar sras gnyis byung ba/ grub chen gong ma 'dra'i sku skyes bzhengs par 'dug na'ang*/ gzhon nu la sku gshegs/ drung chen chos rgyal bzang po ba de nyid/ dgung lo brgyad pa la nub chos lung dgon par/ mkhan chen rin po che rgyal bzang pas drung du bzhugs nas/ chab klog yig rtsis la sogs sku che ba'i yon tan mtha' dag la thugs goms par mdzad/ bcu gnyis pa nas ri tsing dbang rnam sras rgyal mtshan pas drung du byon/ gsol dpon gyi mthil yun ring bzung*/ sku dang gṛb ma bzhin 'bral ba med par phyag phyir brtson cing*/ rdzong gong 'og gi gnyer las kyang yab sras pa'i lo sum cu so bdun mdzad pa'i ring la/ bla brang gi nang du sogs bzang zhing*/ phyi nas dgra thos skad gcig kyang ma phog pas/ bu rta 'dab rgyas pa dang*/ mi sde mnga' zhabs bde skyid la longs spyod pa byung*/ yab bde bar gshegs pa'i dgongs pa rdzogs thabs rnams kyang*/ gtsang g.yas rus phyogs su bzang zhing ngo mtshar che ba'i tshad thub par bsgrubs/ rang gi rdzong mnga' zhabs la/ pha rol gyi dmag dpung stobs chen gyis/ skor rgyag gnod pa yun ring byung dus/

phyi nang kun gyis dpon g.yog thams cad la smon cing | ma khrel sra phur legs par bcas pas/ phyi mi slu brid mgo skor dmag dpung gang gi kyang*/ rang sde gzhom par ma nus pa'i steng du/ stag tshang rdzong gi bstan byus zin pa dang*/ gtsang srid kyi 'go tshugs pa'i skyes bu sde dpon chen por gyur cing*/ der rting nas sa zur kyis rdzong gdan mnga' zhabs gsar du chod pa shin tu mang lags 'di pa yab yum dkar phyogs la mos shing*/ thugs dge dpa' mdzangs ldan pas/ gong 'og sku nye 'brel chags thams cad la bkur skyong*/ 'brog lam zas nor kyi 'dzin tshugs mtshan dag don du ldan pas/ mthun 'jug gang la'ang*/ sus kyang 'gran du med pa'i snyan grags kyi phyogs kun tu khyab la/ chos rgyal chen por gda'o/ /drung chen po ba de nyid dang*/ gdung rgyud lcam mo byang sems bsod nams rgyal mo ba la/ sras po mched gnyis byung pa'i gcen drung rgyal ba dpal bzang po ba yin cing*/ gcung po nang so chos skyong rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ba 'di bas/ mi dbang nam mkha' legs pa'i gsol dpon bzung*/ skur skyong 'brog lam/ sde srid chen po dang*/ yar 'phel la byung ba'i mdzad 'phrin la g.yel mi mnga' zhing*/ sku brtan par bzhugs pa lags so/ /sngon chad sku bsod rnam dkar 'phrin las kun/ /rgyu skyen 'dzoms pas yar 'phel 'byung ba bzhin/ /phyi rab rgyud 'dzin sku tshe brtan pa dang*/ / dpal 'byor mnga' thang che cher dar rgyas shog/// mes po'i shul bzhag rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/gnod sbyin sprul pa rnam rgyal gling pa'i byon tshul/ -PAGE 240--PAGE 239-
